Definition: Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Kenaanah is the name of two Israelites: 1 Kings 22:24 says Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek. 1 Chronicles 7:10 lists another Chenaanah among the sons of Bilhan. 2 Chronicles 18:23 tells the same smiting again, when Zedekiah asked which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Chenaanahs show both sides of the name: one raised a son who struck a prophet, and the other is only a name in a list, remembered by God.
